resources.name: Malawi Police Service
resources.description: Emergency response service for immediate danger and physical threat.
resources.descriptionCh: Thandizo la apolisi pa ngozi yanyamulira.

resources.name: GBV Crisis Line (YONECO)
resources.description: 24/7 toll-free helpline providing confidential counseling, legal advice, and referral for GBV survivors.
resources.descriptionCh: Mzere waulere wa 24/7 wa thandizo la nkhanza za pakhomo ndi chiwerewere.

resources.name: National Child Helpline
resources.description: Toll-free crisis line for children and individuals reporting child abuse or neglect.
resources.descriptionCh: Mzere waulere wothandizira ana ndi kupereka lipoti la nkhanza za ana.

resources.name: Women's Legal Resources Centre (WOLREC)
resources.address: Naperi, Kanyetta Drive, Plot no. SW8/517/3&4, Blantyre
resources.description: Non-governmental organization offering free legal empowerment, court representation, and rights advocacy for women in Malawi.
resources.descriptionCh: Gulu lomwe limapereka thandizo la chilamulo kwa amayi kwa ufulu ndi chilungamo.
